tips.text: Line the 12-hour builds up back to back and rank the Kama and Dual Kamas to 30 while the next one builds.
Keep two weapon slots free before building Dual Kamas; both Kamas must be built and in your inventory.
Join an established clan that already has the Tenno Lab built instead of building your own.
Expect waiting rather than farming: the chain is three days of research plus four 12-hour builds, with no hard drop.
